outcome: Percentage error of weight estimation formulas
cohort: 1958 singleton pregnancies with cephalic presentation, vaginal delivery, and ultrasound examination on the day of delivery, compared to 392 singleton pregnancies delivered by cesarean section with ultrasound examination within 3 days before delivery
finding: Intrapartum sonographic weight estimation systematically underestimated fetal weight, with the Hadlock II formula (using BPD, AC, and FL) demonstrating the best accuracy.
